question: A man driving a car at a speed of 75 km/hr crosses a bridge in 1.4 minutes. Find the length of the bridge.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To find the length directly in kilometres, convert the given time into hours.

Time = 1.4 minutes = 1.4 ÷ 60 hours

Distance = Speed × Time

Distance = 75 × (1.4 ÷ 60) = (75 × 1.4) ÷ 60

Distance = 105 ÷ 60 = 1.75 km

**∴ The correct answer is 1.75 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of the car = 75 km/hr

Time taken to cross the bridge = 1.4 minutes

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

1 km/hr = 5/18 m/s

 
 
• 
 Time taken = 1.4 minutes
 
 
 
 
 
 
• 
 

 Speed = 75 km/hr
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Length of bridge = ?

**Calculations:**

⇒ Speed of the car = 75 × (5/18) = 125/6 m/s

⇒ Time taken = 1.4 × 60 = 84 seconds

⇒ Length of the bridge = Distance covered by the car

⇒ Distance = Speed × Time

⇒ Distance = (125/6) × 84 = 125 × 14

⇒ Distance = 1750 m

⇒ Distance in km = 1750 ÷ 1000 = 1.75 km

**∴ The correct answer is 1.75 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Distance, Speed and Time Formula

Distance = Speed × Time. This is the fundamental relation used to calculate the length of the bridge covered by any vehicle.

Unit Conversion for Speed

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply the speed value by 5/18. To convert back from m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.

Average Speed Concept

When a journey is covered at varying speeds, Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time. For two equal distances covered at speeds A and B, Average Speed = (2 × A × B) ÷ (A + B).
